_comment: Link check runs against a locally served copy of ./out (see the link-check job in .github/workflows/ci.yml) so extensionless routes like /resources resolve the same way GitHub Pages serves them, instead of 404ing against resources.html on the raw filesystem. External links are intentionally skipped: third-party sites going down or rate-limiting CI would make the check flaky, and validating our own pages and in-page anchors is what catches real regressions. The skip pattern excludes every URL that is not on the local server origin (http://localhost:3200).
